meta.title: Math board
meta.description: Express quantity ideas with kid-friendly patterns and named groups; students set their own level colours and attach the board file.

title: Math board
teacherReferenceHint: Read-only reference, not your work. Never included in your answer. Use labels and stated conditions, not visual measurements.
workspaceSubtitle: Place shapes · group them · name the amounts
tapToAdd: Tap to place, or drag one in
settingsIntro: You choose which patterns sit in the toolbox, what each stands for, and which colour marks which amount.
patternsHint: Tap a pattern to put it on the left rail; tap again to tuck it away. Shapes already on the canvas stay.
settingsFutureDone: Saved. New shapes use the new value.
settingsExistingDone: Saved. Existing unmerged shapes also use the new value.
canvasEmpty: Pick a shape on the left to begin
canvasEmptyHint: Drag to arrange · box-select · Shift-click to add
gestureHint: Drag to arrange · box-select · Shift-click to add
groupedNoAlias: Shapes in a group share its name instead of having their own.
noSelection: Select one shape or box-select several to name, group, or merge them.
mergeReason: Merging needs the same shape, the same value, the same name, the same group, and a total that matches one of your levels.
hintGrouped: A whole group is selected: renaming changes the group.
hintSelected: Name, group or merge the selection.
hintEmpty: Drag shapes to arrange; drag on empty space to select several.
inspectorHint: Select shapes to name them here
noteHint: What do these shapes mean? How did you think about it?
noteGeneral: Whole board · not tied to particular shapes
appendHint: Tap shapes to add or remove them; useful on touch screens
fileOpenFallback: Using the standard file picker; the browser may not remember the last location.
clearQuestion: Clear the canvas and this modification record? Files already added to an answer stay. This cannot be undone.
autoClearDone: Canvas and modifications cleared for the new task. Existing answer attachments remain.
autoClearSkipped: A late clear was skipped to keep later edits. Clear manually before using the board.
autoClearError: Automatic clear did not complete. Clear manually before using the board.
inserted: The board file is attached. Review it and send it yourself.
insertedNote: The board file is attached, and your own words are in the composer. Review them and send yourself.
insertFailed: Cannot insert now. Wait until the composer is editable and try again.
localDraft: Your draft stays here until you send it.
fileTooLarge: Choose a board JSON smaller than 256 KB.
storageError: Cannot save this browser draft. Save JSON to keep your work.
loadError: Cannot read the draft. Original data was not overwritten.
configApplied: Your spoken values and colours are now applied.
configGap: Settings history had a gap; retained changes were replayed with their original scopes.
configError: A settings update could not be applied; earlier successful changes were kept.
traceNotice: Changes stay in this browser, without times or drag paths. Your teacher sees them only if attached and sent; sent files remain with the conversation.
traceScope: Retained modifications to this draft so far, not necessarily one continuous sitting. These are observations, not correctness judgments; omitted details are marked.
tracePriorUnknown: Earlier process unknown: the starting board may have content, or history has a gap.
traceTotals: {count} changes recorded; {omitted} changes omitted in the middle.
traceResetQuestion: Keep the board and delete its local modification record to start anew? Existing draft/sent attachments remain. Undo history will also be cleared.
traceResetDone: New attempt started; board kept, earlier process marked unknown.
traceLoadError: Earlier modifications could not be restored and are marked unknown. The board remains usable.
traceRecordError: This change could not be added to the modification record; later process is marked unknown. The board itself is saved.
traceSkipped: Modification record unavailable. The board file is attached; review and send yourself.
demoCopyFull: The geometry canvas is too full. Make room, then try again.
geometryEmpty: Pick a tool, then click on the canvas to start drawing
geometryEmptyHint: Point · segment · triangle · circle · parallelogram · rectangle · polygon
geometryClearDone: Geometry canvas and undo history cleared.
geometryLoadError: Cannot read the geometry draft. Original data was not overwritten.
otherBoardFile: That is the other board's file; the geometry board cannot open it.
geometryClearQuestion: Clear the geometry canvas and its undo history? Files already added to an answer stay. This cannot be undone.
geometryImportFailed: That file could not be opened; the geometry canvas is unchanged.
practiceMoreChapters: Other operation chapters are still to come; basics is not the whole tutorial. Optional file practice does not block basics.
practiceSkippedEnd: This chapter includes skipped steps, not completed operations. Use the chapter list to practise them, or retry this chapter. Nothing was attached or sent.
practiceStorageWarning: Practice progress could not be read or saved reliably. You can continue or exit, but resuming after closing is not guaranteed. Retry this chapter to restart safely. Your real answer is separate.
practiceTargetMissing: A target object is missing. Reset this step or retry this chapter; your real answer is safe.
practiceTitle: Quantity safe practice — separate from your answer
practiceInsertBlocked: Nothing attached. First complete the operation shown above.
practiceFilesUnavailable: File practice is a later optional chapter. No real file was opened or saved.
practiceGoal_add: Tap a left-rail pattern or drag it onto the canvas. A new object must appear. Nothing here changes your real answer. Exit anytime; practice resumes here when browser storage is available.
practiceGoal_move: Drag object 1 to a different place and release it. A press, unmoved click or preview does not finish this step.
practiceGoal_add-second: Add one more pattern from the left rail. Keep object 1 for the following selection tasks.
practiceGoal_select-one: Select only object 1 (the numbered first object). Selecting object 2 or both does not finish this step.
practiceGoal_select-many: Select objects 1 AND 2. Tap Append selection, then tap the other object; or use a selection rectangle / Shift-click. No keyboard required.
practiceGoal_deselect: Tap empty canvas to clear the selection. If Append selection is on, tap Done selecting first. Both objects must become unselected.
practiceGoal_insert: Tap Add to answer now. This is a simulation: no upload, attachment, text insertion or message sending.
practiceGoal_complete: Simulated Add to answer succeeded; nothing was attached or sent. This only confirms tool practice, not mathematical mastery. Exit to continue your unchanged real answer. Other chapters are not completed.
tutorialDone: Tutorial finished. Use undo to remove practice marks.
tutorialInsertPractice: Practice only: when you really answer, tap Add to answer, then review and send yourself.
tutorialInsertLater: Finish this tutorial step first; Add to answer works once the tour ends.
tutorialQAddBody: Tap any pattern on the left to put it on the canvas.
tutorialQColorBody: Tap a value colour below. New patterns will use that amount.
tutorialQAddMoreBody: Tap a left-rail pattern again so you have more to talk about.
tutorialQNoteBody: Tap the speech bubble and write what the shapes mean.
tutorialQNoteSaveBody: When you are done, tap Save. With nothing selected, the note is for the whole board.
tutorialQInsertBody: This attaches the board to the chat. In the tutorial, tapping it only practices—nothing is attached.
tutorialGPointToolBody: Choose Point, then place points on the canvas.
tutorialGPlacePointBody: Tap empty canvas to drop a labelled point.
tutorialGSegmentToolBody: Choose Segment to join two points with a line.
tutorialGDrawSegmentBody: Tap two places (or existing points) on the canvas to draw a segment.
tutorialGNoteBody: Tap the speech bubble and write what you want to explain.
tutorialGNoteSaveBody: When you are done, tap Save.
tutorialGInsertBody: This attaches the geometry board. In the tutorial, tapping it only practices—nothing is attached.
practiceGoal_adjust-color: Choose a DIFFERENT creation color/value below (tap or touch). Repeating the current level does not count; old objects stay unchanged.
practiceGoal_adjust-color-add: Add one pattern using your chosen level. Its value and color must match; old objects must keep their values and colors. If not, reset this step and try again.
practiceGoal_adjust-pattern-add: Open the + pattern library and add a pattern not currently on the rail. Opening the library alone does not count.
practiceGoal_adjust-pattern-use: Close the library with Done and add the pattern you just enabled from the rail. A different pattern does not count.
practiceGoal_adjust-pattern-hide: Open + again and hide that same pattern, then Done. Its existing objects must remain; keep at least one rail pattern.
practiceGoal_adjust-change: Add one more pattern now to make a clear change for Undo and Redo. Earlier additions do not count for this step.
practiceGoal_adjust-undo: Tap Undo once to remove precisely the last addition. If you changed something else, reset this step first.
practiceGoal_adjust-redo: Tap Redo to restore that same addition. An unavailable button or different result does not count.
practiceGoal_adjust-zoom: Tap + or − in the view controls to actually change zoom. You can scroll to see enlarged content; a limit click does not count.
practiceGoal_adjust-fit: Tap Fit view to return from the changed zoom to the whole practice view. Simply clicking an already fitted view does not count.
practiceGoal_adjust-clear: With practice objects present, tap Clear and Confirm. This removes practice objects, all notes, modification records and undo history; it cannot be undone. Real drafts and existing attachments stay untouched.
practiceGoal_adjust-fresh: New practice stage: the cleared work and its history stay cleared. Add a NEW pattern now to prepare a nonempty snapshot for the record-option practice.
practiceGoal_adjust-trace-option: Open More actions and actually toggle Attach modification record. Snapshot and modification record are separate attachments; turning records off does not clear either and still permits a snapshot-only practice insert. This option affects practice only.
practiceGoal_organize-name: Save a new, non-empty name on object 1 (tap or touch Name, then Apply). An empty name, the same name, or naming a different object does not count.
practiceGoal_organize-reselect: Select only object 1 again. Its saved name is still the one you just wrote. Selecting another object does not count.
practiceGoal_organize-peer: Give object 2 that same name. Merging later needs this; it does not replace the naming step. A different name does not count.
practiceGoal_organize-group: Group objects 1 and 2 into one new group. Adding more shapes is not grouping, and a group of only one does not count. Grouping is not merging.
practiceGoal_organize-group-name: Change the group's name to a new non-empty name. Keeping the current name does not count.
practiceGoal_organize-ungroup: Dissolve that group so both members are independent again. A click that leaves the group in place does not count.
practiceGoal_organize-merge: Merge the pair. They need the same shape, value, name, and group (or both ungrouped). A disabled or failed merge does not count. A gray result is not a mistake: it only means the total is not one of the level colors. This does not judge a math answer.
practiceGoal_organize-split: Split that merged object. The recorded sources come back, including shape, value, color, name and note. Splitting something else does not count. Split follows those sources.
practiceGoal_organize-copy: Copy object 1 once. The original stays. Copying a different object does not count.
practiceGoal_organize-crossout: Cross out object 1. It stays on the board, marked crossed out. That is not delete. Undo can restore a cross-out.
practiceGoal_organize-delete: Delete object 1. Other objects stay. Deleting a different object, or clearing the whole board, does not count.
practiceGoal_notes-deselect: Tap empty canvas and clear the whole selection. Where a note goes depends on the current selection; this step clears it first. An already-empty selection does not count, and selecting a different object does not count. A note is your own words, not a checked math conclusion.
practiceGoal_notes-board: With nothing selected, save a non-empty note on the whole board (tap My explanation, then Save). An empty note, Cancel, or a save while an object, group, or multiple objects are selected does not count. A newly added shape is selected automatically, so a save then is not the board note. A note is your own words, not a checked math conclusion; the target depends on the current selection.
practiceGoal_notes-board-read: With nothing still selected, open the note card again. The card shows the whole-board note you just saved. Opening an object or group note does not count. A note is your own words, not a checked math conclusion; the target depends on the current selection.
practiceGoal_notes-object: Select only object 1. If it is in a group, tap Append selection and then tap it, so the whole group is not selected. Save a non-empty note. Saving on another object, the board, or a group, or saving empty text, does not count. A note is your own words, not a checked math conclusion; the target depends on the current selection.
practiceGoal_notes-object-check: Select only object 2. Its note is not the text you just saved on object 1, and object 1 still has that text. A note is your own words, not a checked math conclusion; the target depends on the current selection.
practiceGoal_notes-group: Select the whole target group (tap one member and the group selects together) and save a non-empty note on that group. A member's own note, or the board note, does not count. The group is already there when this step starts. A note is your own words, not a checked math conclusion; the target depends on the current selection.
practiceGoal_notes-group-read: Select that whole group again, then open its note. The card shows the group note. A member's own note does not count as the group note. A note is your own words, not a checked math conclusion; the target depends on the current selection.
practiceGoal_notes-selection: If objects 1 and 2 are still one group, tap Ungroup first. Then use Append selection to select both and save a non-empty note. A different set, a single object, or the board does not count. A note is your own words, not a checked math conclusion; the target depends on the current selection.
practiceGoal_notes-selection-check: Open the note for a different pair, or clear the selection and open the board note. That card does not show the selection note, and the marked objects still have it. A note is your own words, not a checked math conclusion; the target depends on the current selection.
organizeNameExplain: Save a new non-empty name on the marked object.
organizeSelectExplain: Select only the marked object to read its saved name.
organizePeerExplain: Give the second marked object the same saved name.
organizeRenameGroupHint: This step needs its own action, not another rename.
organizeGroupExplain: Make one new group that contains both marked objects.
organizeGroupNameExplain: Change the group to a new non-empty name.
organizeUngroupExplain: Dissolve the marked group so both members are independent.
organizeMergeExplain: Merge the marked pair. A disabled or failed merge does not count, and a gray result is not a mistake.
organizeMergeNoteExplain: A note on these objects has to travel with the merge.
organizeSplitExplain: Split the merged object so its recorded sources return.
organizeCopyExplain: Copy the marked object once and leave the original in place.
organizeCrossoutExplain: Cross out the marked object and leave it on the board. Delete is a different step.
organizeDeleteExplain: Delete only the marked object. Other objects stay; clearing the board does not count.
organizeDeleteSelect: Select the marked object before deleting it.
organizeAddExplain: Adding a shape does not finish this step.
organizeMoveExplain: Moving a shape does not finish this step.
organizeNoteTarget: Notes are practiced in a later chapter.
notesDeselectExplain: Tap empty canvas and clear the current selection. Selecting a different object does not count.
notesEmptyExplain: Save a non-empty note. Empty text does not count.
notesBoardTarget: This step accepts only a whole-board note. Clear the selection, then save; an object, group, or multiple selection does not count.
notesBoardRead: With nothing selected, open the note again and read the board note you just saved. An object or group card does not count.
notesObjectTarget: Save a non-empty note on the marked object. Another object, the board, or a group does not count.
notesObjectCheck: Select only the other practice object. Its note is not the marked object's text, and the marked object still has its own note.
notesGroupTarget: Save a non-empty note on the target group. A member's note or the board note does not count.
notesGroupRead: Select the whole group again and open its note. A member's own note is not the group note.
notesSelectionTarget: Save a non-empty note on this marked set of objects. A different set, a single object, or the board does not count.
notesSelectionCheck: Open another pair, or the board note with nothing selected. That card must not show this selection note, and the marked set still has it.
notesCancelExplain: Cancel does not save the note or advance this step.
notesMiss: This step is not done yet. A note belongs to whatever the current selection names.
textHint: e.g. area = length × width. Save to write it; Esc cancels.
geometryPracticeBasics: Geometry safe basics — separate from your answer
geometryPracticeInsert: Simulation only: a real geometry insert contains one geometry snapshot and your whole-board note, with no geometry modification record. Nothing uploaded, attached, inserted or sent.
geometryPracticeGoal_point: Choose Point, then tap empty canvas to create a free point. Choosing the tool alone is not enough. Exit anytime; browser storage enables resume.
geometryPracticeGoal_segment: Choose Segment. Tap your first point, then another position to finish a segment. A first endpoint or failed drawing does not count.
geometryPracticeGoal_triangle: Choose Triangle. Reuse the segment endpoints and tap a third position to finish the shape. No lengths or angles are judged.
geometryPracticeGoal_polygon: Choose Polygon. Tap at least three vertices in a free area, then tap the starting point again to close it. An unfinished outline does not count.
geometryPracticeGoal_circle: Choose Circle. In a free area tap the centre, then a point on the circle to finish it. A centre alone does not count.
geometryPracticeGoal_select-one: Choose Select and tap only the first point (A). You can also drag a selection rectangle on mouse or touch, without a keyboard. Wrong selections do not count.
geometryPracticeGoal_deselect: Tap empty canvas and release to clear all selection. A hover does not count.
geometryPracticeGoal_insert: Tap Add to answer to simulate. Real geometry insertion has only a geometry snapshot and your whole-board note, no geometry modification record. Nothing here uploads or sends.
geometryPracticeGoal_complete: Basic operation practice completed, not mathematical mastery or completion of other chapters. Nothing was attached or sent. Exit to continue your real answer.
geometryPracticeConstruct: Geometry construct practice — separate from your answer
geometryPracticeGoal_construct-parallelo: Choose Parallelogram and finish a new parallelogram in three clicks. Choosing the tool, an unfinished preview, or a plain polygon does not count. Lengths, angles, and parallel sides are not judged.
geometryPracticeGoal_construct-rectangle: Choose Rectangle and finish a new rectangle in three clicks. A parallelogram or an unfinished preview does not count. Right angles and side lengths are not judged.
geometryPracticeGoal_construct-select-si: Choose Select and click one segment, or one edge of a polygon, rectangle, or parallelogram. Both ends must be free points and must not already have a midpoint. A point, a circle, or an empty selection does not count.
geometryPracticeGoal_construct-midpoint: Keep that side selected and tap Midpoint so the side gains its midpoint. A free point, or a click while Midpoint is disabled, does not count.
geometryPracticeGoal_construct-drag: Drag the marked free point and release after it moves. A press that does not move does not count. A derived point cannot be dragged directly and is not this step's target.
geometryPracticeGoal_construct-auxiliary: Turn Auxiliary on, then draw a new auxiliary figure yourself. Turning the switch on, with no new auxiliary figure, does not count.
After the auxiliary figure is on the board, turn Auxiliary off. Turning it off before that figure exists does not finish the drawing step.
geometryPracticeGoal_construct-complete: Construct practice is finished. That records the operations only, not a measured relation or a mathematical conclusion. Exit to continue your real answer.
geometryPracticeEdit: Geometry edit and notes practice — separate from your answer
geometryPracticeGoal_edit-rename: With the marked point selected, choose Rename point and save a new non-empty name. An empty name, cancel, an unchanged name, or a duplicate the board rejects does not count. Shapes keep the same point.
geometryPracticeGoal_edit-text-add: Choose Text, click empty canvas, and save non-empty writing. Cancel or an empty save does not count. The words are your own; they are not graded as geometry.
geometryPracticeGoal_edit-text-change: Choose Edit text and save a different wording of that same writing. A second text, cancel, or an empty save does not count.
geometryPracticeGoal_edit-delete: Keep the marked object selected and choose Delete selected. Something else that was already here must remain. Deleting a different object, or clearing the whole board, does not count.
geometryPracticeGoal_edit-point-note: With the marked point selected, choose My explanation and save a non-empty note on that point. A text element or a note on a shape does not count. The note is your own words.
geometryPracticeGoal_edit-element-note: With the marked shape selected, choose My explanation and save a shape note of 1 to 20 characters so a short label can appear. A point note, a text element, an empty note, or a longer note does not count.
geometryPracticeGoal_edit-caption: Click the short label on the canvas, without hovering, and save a different note on that same shape. Opening the card without saving, or editing a different shape, does not count.
geometryPracticeGoal_edit-deselect: Click empty canvas and release to clear the selection.
geometryPracticeGoal_edit-board-note: With nothing selected, choose My explanation and save a non-empty note for the whole board. An empty save does not count. A note on a point or a shape does not count, including one taken by a newly selected object.
geometryPracticeGoal_edit-complete: Edit and notes practice is finished. Text and notes are your own words, not a geometry verdict or a right answer. Exit to continue your real answer.
